Smart Compact v1.0.0 — Progressive context compaction with memory preservation

- Implements a 4-phase "Scan, Extract, Check, Compact" workflow to prevent data loss before context compression.
- Automatically reviews large tool outputs, extracts key information, and writes it into dedicated memory files.
- Generates a detailed pre-compaction checklist highlighting what has been saved or still needs attention.
- Only proceeds to compacting when user confirms; never overwrites existing memory.
- Triggered by context nearing limit, user command, or pre-compact actions; fully transparent with users.
